item.description: Online speculation followed a perceived change in his X profile bio.
item.content:encoded:
Online speculation followed a perceived change in his X profile bio.

Original source: https://x.com/LLMJunky/status/2081114803834376218

Users on X questioned whether Andrej Karpathy had removed his Anthropic affiliation from his profile bio, with screenshots and comments circulating widely. Some posts claimed the line was gone while others confirmed it remained as MTS @ Anthropic. Karpathy replied directly to the rumors, stating he is not leaving the company and labeling the claims as weird misinformation. The episode highlighted rapid online reactions to minor profile edits among prominent AI figures.

item.title: OpenAI Researcher Backs Global AI Capabilities Slowdown
item.description: Roon signals hypothetical support for coordinating a global pause on AI capabilities.
item.content:encoded:
Roon signals hypothetical support for coordinating a global pause on AI capabilities.

Original source: https://x.com/tszzl/status/2081122092096065771

Digg story: https://digg.com/tech/y5g5698u

Roon, a pseudonymous OpenAI technical staff member, posted that he would likely press a button for a coordinated global slowdown on AI capabilities development. The statement prompted replies from other researchers including Nick Cammarata, who noted most people close to the research frontier say the same and called it a coordination problem best solved by governments. Geoffrey Irving countered that partial slowdown measures already exist and should not be dismissed as magic. Matthew Barnett stated he would not support such a pause, while Beff Jezos argued no such button can exist without massively increasing risks. The exchange reflects ongoing internal debates about feasibility and enforcement.

item.title: Google Gemma Models Surpass 900 Million Downloads
item.description: Google DeepMind's open-weight LLM family achieves widespread adoption among developers and researchers.
item.content:encoded:
Google DeepMind's open-weight LLM family achieves widespread adoption among developers and researchers.

Original source: https://huggingface.co/models?search=gemma-4

Digg story: https://digg.com/tech/25r4im0p

Google's Gemma open model family, including variants like Gemma 4, ShieldGemma, and MedGemma, has reached over 900 million downloads total. The Gemma 4 series alone accounts for more than 300 million. Google DeepMind executives including Demis Hassabis and CEO Sundar Pichai publicly celebrated the milestone, with Pichai noting a goal of 1 billion downloads next. The achievement reflects strong uptake by the developer community on platforms like Hugging Face.

item.content:encoded:

Digg story: https://digg.com/tech/fd8xb53d

Matt Shumer posted a video of a browser-based first-person shooter created entirely by Claude Opus 5 from a single detailed prompt requesting AAA quality. The demo shows urban combat gameplay featuring custom-coded environments, UI elements, scoring, health, ammo, weapons, enemy AI, and audio with no external assets used. Shumer shared the prompt and linked to a public code repository. Other users commented on the speed of AI progress in game creation and its implications for professional developers.

item.title: Critics Accuse Anthropic of Lobbying Against Open Source
item.description: Social media users accuse Anthropic of lobbying to restrict open-source AI competitors while shielding its closed models.
item.content:encoded:
Social media users accuse Anthropic of lobbying to restrict open-source AI competitors while shielding its closed models.

Original source: https://aiworld.eu/story/the-new-engines-of-open-source-ai

Digg story: https://digg.com/tech/hc6rjs0n

Twitter exchanges show multiple creators and founders criticizing Anthropic employees for mocking NVIDIA's open-source CUDA and driver support. Replies allege the company spends tens of millions lobbying governments to limit competitors' open-source work under a safety pretext. Commenters distinguish this from any requirement that Anthropic itself release models, focusing instead on perceived efforts to block rivals. The thread references NVIDIA CEO comments and highlights one-sided framing in ongoing AI governance debates, with no official Anthropic statement included in the supplied lines.

item.title: OpenAI Mitigates Elevated Error Rates on ChatGPT and Codex
item.description: Outage overnight prompted service recovery and compensation for affected users.
item.content:encoded:
Outage overnight prompted service recovery and compensation for affected users.

Original source: https://status.openai.com/incidents/x9p6qd31

Digg story: https://digg.com/tech/1j6uq4qx

OpenAI encountered a near-global outage impacting ChatGPT and Codex services between 2am and 4am. Users reported repeated 503 errors throughout the morning. The company responded by applying mitigations to resolve elevated error rates and confirmed service recovery. As compensation, usage limits were reset for all affected Work and Codex users, restoring weekly quotas for paid subscribers. Multiple reports confirm the reset occurred after the outage was addressed overnight.
